class.name: pendulum_pvt_control/PendulumPVTController
class.description: PVT / MIT-mode (CiA-402 mode 5) impedance controller for a single revolute joint. With drive_side_pd:true (real hardware) it claims the position, velocity, effort, kp and kd command interfaces and streams the full PVT payload to a myActuator X6 that runs the PD law internally. With drive_side_pd:false (Gazebo sim) it claims only effort and replicates the PD law in software. Supports gravity, inertia and viscous feedforward; FREE / PVT modes via std_srvs/Trigger services.
